query.title: Company name, registration number, director, or shareholder
query.description: A single search term. What it matches depends on 'Search type' below: an entity name/partial name/registration number, a director's surname, or a shareholder's name. Must not contain a comma or an '=' character (see README).

queries.title: Multiple search terms
queries.description: Multiple search terms to run in one job. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: Which register field to search against.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch director/secretary/shareholder detail
fetchDetails.description: When on (default), each matched entity gets a follow-up lookup for its Directors/Secretaries/Shareholders on file. When off, only the raw search-result row is returned, which is faster for a broad search.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return (and, if enabled, fetch detail for) per search term. The register itself returns every match in one response (no server-side pagination) -- this only caps how many this actor keeps.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many searches / detail lookups to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
